_: Editorial for polo-marble. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-classic.json.
_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: A gold mirage that moves like marble across the shirt. Softer than the Gold Dust and closer to a fabric than a print.
pieceHeadline: Gold, but poured rather than thrown
pieceParas: Where the Gold Dust flecks, this one flows. The mirage pattern moves in wide bands across the body, so the shirt reads as a material rather than as something with a graphic on it.
It is the most expensive-looking thing in the range and the hardest to photograph, because the effect depends on the light moving across it.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, moving. The pattern needs motion and raking light to read — a static front-on shot in flat light will lose the whole effect. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
